title: Serendipity Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutSerendipity ~ 22 Daybreak Court ~ Santa Rosa Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 10% Discount off Spring Rates! 3-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. Serendipity is a warm, family friendly home located in the gated Sunrise Beach subdivision next to Gulf Place. With 2,607sq of living (1,890 interior), Serendipity sleeps up to 8 guests and offers 3 bedrooms, 3 baths, multiple porches offering either Gulf or pool views, private fenced, heated pool (heating fee applies, available only March 1st thru May 15th), parking for 3 cars ONLY, Wi-Fi, private neighborhood boardwalk to beach and a short walk to the delightful restaurants, eclectic shops and colorful galleries of local 30A artists in Gulf Place. Daily beach service set-up (4 chairs, 2 umbrellas) is included with your rental! PLEASE NOTE - On-street parking is prohibited in the neighborhood. Golf carts are allowed, but must be parked in the driveway of the home only and counts as one vehicle toward parking maximum. Ground Floor: 1 bedroom. 1 bath. Living room. Laundry. Dining table seats 6. Island seating for 4. Fully equipped kitchen. Covered porch. #1 Bedroom has a Queen bed Full bath, with tub/shower Second Floor: 2 bedrooms. 2 baths. Covered porches. #2 En-Suite Family Bedroom has 1 Queen bed, 1 Trundle bed (2 Twins), tub/shower, covered porch #3 En-Suite (Master) Bedroom has a King bed, sitting area, double vanities, tub/shower, covered porch. Third Floor: Tower with daybed seating, bistro table for 2, Gulf view open balcony. Please note – balcony overlooking pool is not accessible to guests. Amenities: Business Features Hi Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 4 Smart TV’s, TiVo on LR and Master Bdrm TV’s Distinctive Features Gulf views Private fenced, heated pool (heating fee applies, available only March 1st thru May 15th) Gated neighborhood Daily beach service included (4 chairs, 2 umbrellas) Bed, bath, kitchen linens provided Beach Gear credit General Features Driveway parking for 3 cars ONLY On-street parking is prohibited in the neighborhood 1 King bed, 2 Queen beds, Trundle bed (2 Twins) 3 full bathrooms, iron, ironing board, 3 hair dryers, outdoor charcoal grill w/ grill utensils, outdoor shower, three outdoor porches with Gulf views, porch furniture. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, granite countertops, stainless appliances including electric range with glass cooktop and double oven, refrigerator with ice maker, microwave, dishwasher, Keurig + drip coffee maker, toaster, blender, washer, dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Gulf Place (3/10th mile)Grayton Beach (4 miles) Seaside (6 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
